This composition looks like an 18Ni maraging steel, specifically a C300 or T-250 type. Ni is 18.1%, Mo is 2.2%, Ti is 2.5%, and Co is about 0. A Co-free maraging steel with high Ti, such as 18Ni(350) or a Co-free grade, would reach roughly 1700–2000 MPa when aged. This is an estimate from memory of typical grades. I did not calculate it or look anything up.
